CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `border_detection_records` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `original_image_url` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `original_image_key` varchar(500),
  `original_width` int,
  `original_height` int,
  `detection_status` enum('pending', 'processing', 'detected', 'not_found', 'failed') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  `border_coordinates` json,
  `detection_confidence` int,
  `cropped_image_url` varchar(500),
  `cropped_image_key` varchar(500),
  `cropped_width` int,
  `cropped_height` int,
  `perspective_corrected` boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  `processing_time_ms` int,
  `error_message` text,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `user_id_idx` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `detection_status_idx` (`detection_status`),
  INDEX `created_at_idx` (`created_at`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `handwriting_recognition_records` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `image_url` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `image_key` varchar(500),
  `preprocess_config` json,
  `recognition_status` enum('pending', 'preprocessing', 'recognizing', 'completed', 'failed') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  `raw_ocr_text` text,
  `raw_ocr_confidence` decimal(5,2),
  `enhanced_ocr_text` text,
  `enhanced_ocr_confidence` decimal(5,2),
  `special_symbols` json,
  `handwriting_analysis` json,
  `processing_time_ms` int,
  `error_message` text,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `user_id_idx` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `recognition_status_idx` (`recognition_status`),
  INDEX `created_at_idx` (`created_at`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ocr_enhancement_configs` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `auto_border_detection` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `border_detection_sensitivity` enum('low', 'medium', 'high') DEFAULT 'medium' NOT NULL,
  `auto_perspective_correction` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `auto_contrast_enhancement` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `auto_noise_reduction` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `auto_binarization` boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  `handwriting_mode` boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  `math_symbol_enhancement` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `chemical_formula_enhancement` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `default_subject` enum('chinese', 'math', 'english', 'physics', 'chemistry', 'biology', 'politics', 'history', 'geography'),
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `user_id_idx` (`user_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ocr_processing_batches` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `batch_name` varchar(100),
  `total_images` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `processed_images` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `successful_images` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `failed_images` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `processing_config` json,
  `status` enum('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  `started_at` timestamp,
  `completed_at` timestamp,
  `total_processing_time_ms` int,
  `error_message` text,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `user_id_idx` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `status_idx` (`status`),
  INDEX `created_at_idx` (`created_at`)
);
